dispute_ticket.description: My passenger spilled a large bubble tea on the rear seat last night. I paid S$90.00 for the seat to be professionally cleaned. Please charge the passenger. Some of my photos did not upload but I have the others.

chat_logs.content: omg my bubble tea tipped over onto the seat, so sorry!
The seat is soaked, I will have to clean it tonight.
I'll pay for the cleaning, just send me the bill. Really sorry

app_events.details: Rider R-7105 booked RYDE-PT-005 from Vivocity to Bishan.

Driver selected 5 photos. 3 uploaded (metadata 22:24, 22:25, 22:26, showing milk tea on the rear seat and car plate SLR 3301 D). 2 photos failed to upload (sync_error, retries exhausted). Drop-off was 22:20.
Driver submitted receipt from a professional car-seat cleaner for S$90.00, dated 2026-10-09 09:30, plate SLR 3301 D, with company stamp.

cleaning_fee_max.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip.

cleaning_claim_evidence_required.value: photos taken within 30 minutes after drop-off and a receipt where available
cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver must provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only. The photos that uploaded are the ones assessed.

typical_spill_cleaning_range.value: S$40-S$100 for food or drink spillage
typical_spill_cleaning_range.text: The usual cost range in SGD for cleaning a food or drink spill. It governs whether the claimed amount is reasonable.

expected_outcome.reason: Three photos that did upload were taken 22:24-22:26, within 6 minutes of the 22:20 drop-off, and show the spill and the plate. The rider admits it twice in chat (22:08, 22:23) and offers to pay. The receipt of S$90.00 is dated the next morning and sits inside the S$40-S$100 spill range and well under the S$150 cap. The two photos that failed to sync are beside the point because the other three and the admission already prove the mess.
